scripts.build: if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then flutter build macos; else echo 'App scaffolded in Milestone 6'; fi
scripts.build:apk: if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then flutter build apk; else echo 'App scaffolded in Milestone 6'; fi
scripts.build:web: if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then flutter build web; else echo 'App scaffolded in Milestone 6'; fi
